text: Kevin - client pitch w/ Baker & Co on May 14. remind me to send him the deck the day before + text good luck that morning
dry cleaning Thurs. pick up suit before 6
Jasmine (Jas) back from mat leave 6/2. baby Leo 4 months now. she's a bit anxious abt first wk back
call w/ Antoine re Q3 budget - his boss wants cuts across the board. he's stressed, def check in end of wk
Ifeoma - presenting to the board June 3rd. v nervous. remind me to message her afterwards to see how it went
Salma's leaving do cancelled - she's staying on after all, got counter offer + promoted to team lead
renew passport / book eye test / car MOT due 7/19

Teresa @ lunch: daughter starts uni in Sept, Leeds - halls booked, moving in the 19th. Teresa dreading the drive up + the empty house afterwards, keeps saying she's fine but clearly not. hubby Marcus doing most of the driving. their younger one still at home, does rowing, regionals in Oct. she said she'd bring photos back
Florin - allergic to nuts, don't order the satay for the team lunch
Aditi interview w/ Wang Logistics tmrw 10am. ask how it went the next day
Shanice & her partner Karim closing on the house Aug 8. moving the week after. they've got a dog, Biscuit, who hates the car apparently
Kate - mgr review moved to May 20. she thinks it's going badly. check in that evening
note: Suzanne Rossi = new client contact at Dubois. prefers email not calls. into cycling
Carmen's mum had a fall, in hospital since Sun. Carmen working from home this wk. don't forget to send flowers
Samir - first marathon Oct 12! training since spring. remind me the day before to wish him luck + ask how it went a few days after
gym 7am Mon/Wed/Fri from now on. meal prep Sun
Ming said Dong (her brother) is getting married in Singapore, March. she's flying out 2 wks before

Ruby - redundancy meeting on 4/30 w/ HR + her manager. scared, 12 yrs there. whole comms team at risk, only 2 roles left. she's been applying elsewhere quietly, one interview w/ a charity on 5/6. I offered to go for coffee afterwards. remind me to text her that morning and check how the charity one went the day after
Chantal's birthday 9/9 - mentioned wanting a proper espresso machine. chip in w/ Tamar?

Colm off sick again, back thing - slipped disc apparently, MRI on 3/12. covering his clients till further notice, Isaac taking the Andersson account + the Bianchi renewal. Colm v worried abt falling behind, keeps emailing from bed. told him to switch off. his wife Siobhan said he's not sleeping. should send something - he likes crime novels
Farah - passed her CIPD exam!! congrats msg
Siobhan + Gabriel - 10th wedding anniv June 18. going to Lisbon that weekend. their kids staying w/ her sister
Ebony new starter on my team from Monday. need to set up her laptop + intro call w/ Dalia the day before
Aurelio says his landlord's selling. flat hunting again. viewing Sat morning, another next Tues
Emeka - promotion to senior eng confirmed, announced 5/28. drinks after? org it
Ann's dad passed last wk. funeral Friday. she's off til the 15th. must send a card before then
returns: Amazon parcel, library books (due 11/2). also cancel the gym trial before it renews
Jasmine's boss (Kowalski) moving to Berlin office. Jas might go for his role. interview prob early Dec
Kevin said the Baker pitch went well!! they want a follow up on 5/21
Kate's cat Pepper had surgery yday - lump removed. waiting on results. ask her Thurs how Pepper's doing
Antoine - vegan, also hates karaoke. so not the xmas party venue then lol
Teresa's son Gabriel got into Leeds - same uni as his sister. she's thrilled
Isaac - offsite in Denver July 9-11. flying out the day before. asked me to cover standup
remind me to email Florin re contract on Monday, then chase Suzanne the day after if no reply

Salma pregnant!! due in Feb. hasn't told the team yet, waiting till after the 20 wk scan on 9/30. she's had awful morning sickness, lives on ginger biscuits. her husband Karim (not our Karim) already painting the nursery. she wants to keep working til Christmas then go off. must be careful not to book her on the Denver trip
Dalia's wedding - Nov 22nd. RSVP by 9/15. she's registered at John Lewis
Marcus & Ifeoma - joint presentation to the client 6/10, rehearsal 6/9 evening. both pretty calm abt it

Ming - started a pottery class, Weds evenings, w/ her flatmate. loves it, already made a wonky mug. thinking of a weekend course in Cornwall in Aug. bday is June 27th - maybe a nice wheel tool set? or vouchers for the course. ask Dong what she's already got
Karim - job offer from Bianchi, starts 8/1. leaving our dept end of July. leaving drinks TBC
haircut moved to the 14th. dentist still Tues 3pm
Ruby update: redundancy went ahead. she's ok-ish, already applying. ask in a couple wks if she needs a reference
Aditi didn't get the Wang job :( feedback was 'not enough people mgmt'. she's gutted. check in next wk
Chantal - kid's school play Thurs eve, so she's leaving at 3 that day. cover her 4pm
quarterly offsite was meant to be 8/14 - called off, budget. Kevin's doing a team lunch instead that wk
Siobhan's sister Tamar is visiting from Dublin next month - bringing the new baby. Siobhan v excited
Dr Walsh appt 10/3 9:15am. fast from midnight the night before. bring the referral letter
Shanice - her mum's 60th on May 2nd, surprise party. I'm doing the cake. she wants help w/ the playlist, send her some ideas the week before
Samir - his dad having heart surgery on the 18th. Samir taking the wk off. remind me to text him that evening, and again a few days after
spoke to Colm - back on light duties from 11/4. still physio twice a wk. he's frustrated

Emeka mentioned his twins turn 5 next Sat - Peppa Pig party (send help), 20 kids + a bouncy castle. his mother-in-law flying in from Lagos the day before to help. gets on w/ Isaac, they both coach under 7s footy on Sundays. Emeka also training for a 10k in Nov
Farah moving to Manchester in Jan, partner got a job there. she'll go remote. sad
pay council tax / book flights for Xmas / sort spare room before Mum visits 12/20
Gabriel - started at the agency today. nervous but keen. his manager is Ann. coffee w/ him next Weds to see how wk 1 went
Suzanne (Suze) - client dinner on 7/24 w/ her + Antoine. she's gluten free, pick somewhere suitable. remind me to book the week before and confirm that morning
Tamar's daughter Ruby graduated yday - first in Law. Tamar so proud. card
Ebony - doing a half Ironman Sept 7. swims every morning before work. ask the week after how it went

Kevin and his wife expecting #2, due Halloween lol. he's taking 4 wks paternity from Oct 25, so I'm covering the Baker account + his 1:1s w/ Ebony. handover meeting 10/20. their eldest Ruby starts nursery the same month, poor guy. he seemed knackered but happy. remind me to organise a card + collection the week before he goes
new laptop arrives Fri. back up old one tonight. wipe it the day after

Dalia says her boss is micromanaging everything since the reorg - every email cc'd, daily status reports. she's miserable, thinking of leaving. has a call w/ a recruiter Thurs. dog Rolo keeping her sane, long walks every evening. don't mention it to Karim. grab a drink w/ her after the all-hands on the 9th

Aurelio - got the flat! Hackney, moves in 6/1. housewarming the weekend after. I said I'd bring a plant. remind me to buy one the day before and ask if he needs help w/ the van that morning. also his sister Carmen might need a lift from the station afterwards
